_about: Public-domain Henry Blunt (1794-1843), evangelical incumbent of Holy Trinity, Upper Chelsea, and rector of Streatham, for the Word Hoard: his Lent lectures on Abraham, Jacob, Elisha, St Peter, St Paul and the history of our Lord, A Practical Exposition of the Epistles to the Seven Churches (1839), Discourses on the Doctrinal Articles (1839), Sermons Preached in Trinity Church, Upper Chelsea (1840), A Family Exposition of the Pentateuch (vol. 3) and Posthumous Sermons (1852). J. J. Blunt and J. H. Blunt are other men. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 65 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

hblunt-abraham: Twelve lectures upon the history of Abraham (London : J. Hatchard, 1833)
hblunt-st-peter: Nine lectures upon the history of Saint Peter (London : J. Hatchard & Son, 1836)
hblunt-seven-churches: A practical exposition of the Epistles to the seven churches of Asia (Philadelphia :4bHooker & Claxton, 1839)
hblunt-doctrinal-articles: Discourses on some of the doctrinal articles of the church of England; also lectures on the history of Saint Peter (Philadelphia, Hooker and Claxton, 1839)
hblunt-elisha: Lectures on the history of Elisha. By the Rev. Henry Blunt (London : J. Hatchard & son [etc.], 1840)
hblunt-our-lord-1: Lectures upon the history of Our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ (Philadelphia, H. Hooker, 1840)
hblunt-chelsea-sermons: Sermons preached in Trinity Church, Upper Chelsea (Philadelphia : Herman Hooker, 1840)
hblunt-st-paul: Lectures upon the history of St. Paul : delivered during Lent, at the Church of the Holy Trinity, Upper Chelsea (Philadelphia : Hooker & Agnew, 1841)
hblunt-pentateuch-3: A family exposition of the Pentateuch, vol. 3 (Philadelphia : Hooker & Agnew, 1841)
hblunt-jacob: Eight lectures upon the history of Jacob: delivered during Lent, 1828, at the Church of St. Luke, Chelsea (London : J. Hatchard & Son, 1845)
